title: the draft homes
description: User story under REQ-188. Every pre-populated shape across the three draft homes (`TAC.purpose`, `coreEntities[].description`, `TAC.interfaces[].description`) carries the `[draft]` marker; `shapes:draftSettled` reports all three id forms so nothing drafted reads as settled.
asA: engineer picking up an intent-complete tree

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given a coreEntities entry whose description starts with [draft], when D3 runs, then shapes:draftSettled fails TAD.entity:<name>.
[happy] given a TAC whose purpose starts with [draft], when D3 runs, then shapes:draftSettled fails <tacId> and shapes:tacHasInterface treats the TAC as present.
[happy] given the three marker homes cleared, when D3 runs, then shapes:draftSettled passes.
[failure] given a [draft] recordShape without fields:, when D3 runs, then shapes:templateMarkers fails it exactly as a settled one.
[must-not] given any [draft] content, when readiness runs, then no productOwner check reads it.
